summary: The session discusses the evolution and significance of data fabric as a foundational architecture for data management, particularly in supporting AI readiness and advanced analytics. It emphasizes the role of metadata in creating a flexible and optimal data management environment, and outlines practical steps for implementing data fabric. The presentation also explores the vendor landscape and considerations for building or buying data fabric solutions.

key_points: Data fabric is essential for long-term strategic data management architecture.
It supports AI readiness and advanced analytics use cases.
The transition from traditional data warehouses to logical data warehouses.
The importance of metadata in supporting data integration and orchestration.
Data fabric is a pattern integrating multiple components for optimal data management.
It enables flexible data handling from various sources.
Active metadata drives insights and supports AI use cases.
Data fabric utilizes metadata for creating a knowledge layer.
Data fabric supports multiple deployment options for unified semantics.
It complements data mesh architectures for federated data management.
Start with cataloging data and building a metadata foundation.
Incorporate knowledge graphs for enhanced data relationships.
Data Ops combines orchestration and observability for automation.
Self-service capabilities empower users to manage their data.
Vendors are evolving to offer integrated data management solutions.
Considerations for building versus buying data fabric solutions.

key_takeaways: Invest in a strong metadata foundation to support AI readiness.
Utilize active metadata for continuous insights and operational efficiency.
Consider the integration of data fabric with data mesh for improved data management.
